_comment: Glimmerline's hosted remote config (ITERATION-8, 2026-10-30): the document served at https://sixandahalf.studio/glimmerline/remote_config.json (copied to the studio site repo as /glimmerline/remote_config.json), the URL config/secrets.json names as remote_config_url before the rc5 release build. The same shape as config/remote_defaults.json, which is the fallback with the same values when this file is unreachable. ads_enabled true and ads_network "max": ads on AppLovin MAX (Unity Ads as a bidder), consent by region (the opt-in sheet after the first solve in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland; analytics on by default with the Settings switches elsewhere); allowance_enabled false: no daily allowance. The kill switch: set ads_enabled to false (or ads_network to "none") and push the site repo, and every install stops initializing the ad SDK at its next launch after GitHub Pages' cache, about ten minutes; "admob" selects the rc3 AdMob path, which needs the approved AdMob account and its published consent messages. Units: puzzles, seconds, days; cartridges.<id> holds a cartridge's own values, merged over the flat ones for that app.
